briefdescription.para: Return true if this asm streamer supports emitting unformatted text to the .s file with EmitRawText.
EmitRawText - If this file is backed by an assembly streamer, this dumps the specified string in the output .s file.

detaileddescription.para: This capability is indicated by the hasRawTextSupport() predicate.
